decisions.reason: Premium customer support builds directly on the firm's existing support capabilities, so it can readily interpret feedback and improve, making early removal unlikely.
The software version management tool draws on the firm's software development expertise, allowing it to assimilate user input and continue improving the product.

The data-processing contract tool requires legal and regulatory knowledge that lies outside the firm's core information-service capabilities, limiting its ability to learn from early results and improve.
Scalable hosting for agencies is closely related to the firm's existing hosting infrastructure and customer knowledge, so it can effectively absorb and exploit market feedback.
